BEFORE YOU REACH OUT

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Have something else in mind?
Ask Daniel directly ↗

Is the inspection and estimate free?

Yes. You can request a free exterior inspection and estimate. We’ll confirm your project details and arrange a time after you submit the request.

Where do you work?

Daniel serves homeowners in Maryland, Washington, DC, and Northern Virginia. Share your ZIP code so we can confirm availability for your location and project.

What happens during the appointment?

We’ll discuss your concerns, inspect the relevant areas, and review findings and potential solutions. The time needed depends on the scope; we’ll clarify that when arranging your visit.

Do I need to know which products I want?

No. Tell me what you’re noticing and what you’d like to improve. We can compare materials, appearance, maintenance, and budget during the consultation.

Who will install the work?

Your project is through Presidential Exteriors. Ask Daniel to walk through the assigned installation team, relevant training, and how your project will be managed before you commit.

Can we discuss financing?

Yes. Ask about the options available for your project. Approval, rates, and terms depend on the program and application.

What warranty comes with my project?

Coverage depends on the selected products, installation, and program. We’ll review the applicable written material and labor terms, exclusions, and transferability with your proposal.

Does this form book an appointment?

It sends an inspection request to Daniel. Your appointment is confirmed only after we connect and agree on a time.
